name: CoreWeave Ellendale ND

timeline.event: CoreWeave signed the first lease package for 250 MW. No buildings online yet. This is according to an SEC 8-k filing from this date.
A new 150 MW lease brings CoreWeave to 400 MW total contracted. The project is now clearly scheduled to be a three-building CoreWeave campus.
The first 50 MW slice of Building 1 has reached Ready for Service status according to this report. This is the first point where we would count any CoreWeave capacity as operational.

This Applied Digital report says the rest of Building 1 has reached Ready for Service, bringing the first building to its expected 100 MW. We can treat this as the first completed data center building.

According to satellite imagery, Building 1 looks complete and in service, with the surrounding power/cooling equipment also operational. (Note: this image doesn't provide a view of buildings 2 or 3, though it's very safe to assume they're…

According to satellite imagery, Building 2 is fully roofed and shell complete, with rooftop chillers mostly installed. Building 3 construction is well underway, with about 1/4 of the roofing done and the foundation laid out.
According to the schedule, Building 2 should be online sometime in the second half of 2026. We can estimate the end of 2026 for 250 MW operational.
According to schedule, Building 3 should come online in the first half of 2027. That would bring the full PF1 campus to 400 MW, according to the contract.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: CoreWeave Ellendale ND: current power 68 MW; owner CoreWeave.

explain: CoreWeave Ellendale ND is an operating AI data center in Ellendale, ND, owned by coreweave. Epoch AI estimates it draws 68 MW today and 520 MW when finished.
